title: See Which Runes My New Session Loaded

steps.intent: start a new Claude tab, and in the Runes panel choose a vault card and press Start Session, without sending a message
open Runes in that tab and find which vault I picked in the Runes panel, by name
find how many runes it loaded and read a few of their names
check the Lock button reads Lock, not Locked, since I have sent nothing yet
